annotations.title: Browse and look up my saved ratings

description: Use for my ratings, all the movies and shows I rated, understand my taste, what I loved or disliked, and have I rated this title. Omit title_ids to browse the viewer's full rated list, independently of bookmarks. Browse with an optional title fragment, kind, highest/lowest/title sort, and next_offset; up to 50 titles per page. For a requested full-history taste analysis, read all pages and use both high and low ratings with the returned descriptions, genres, subgenres and tags. Curate a few picks using that evidence; personal predictions are secondary when requested. Alternatively supply up to ten resolved title_ids to check saved ratings or confirmed absence for those specific titles. Requires ratings:read. Saved ratings, audience scores and personal predictions are distinct. A successful lookup confirms the connection. Cannot read another account or change ratings.

limit.description: Rated titles per page. Use up to fifty and follow next_offset for a requested full-history taste analysis.
limit.title: Limit

offset.description: Use next_offset to continue through the rated list.
offset.title: Offset

query.description: Optional title fragment to search across all rated titles when title_ids is empty.
query.title: Query

sort.description: Browse alphabetically, highest ratings first, or lowest ratings first. Use both high and low ratings when exploring taste.
sort.title: Sort

title_ids.description: Optional specific titles to check, including whether they are unrated. Omit to browse the viewer's rated movies and shows without knowing their IDs.
title_ids.title: Title Ids
